kinematics.coupling: Same signed front/rear rack translation produces opposite rear steering through baked fore/aft geometry. Per-corner suspension q may differ; use solver separately.
kinematics.steering_not_independent_input: Solve fixed tie length from rack and suspension; do not yaw wheels independently.
kinematics.zero_rack_bump_steer: Analytically cancels in ideal parallel-arm geometry
kinematics.nominal_Ackermann: Approximate;0.901degree maximum screen error, no tire-slip/dynamics validation

rotation_order.arms: Apply native side properRz(pi) ifright, station translation; rotateworldRx(side*q) about each fixed upper/lower pivot.
rotation_order.upright: Baked native handed mesh plusstationtranslation. Rotate about nominal vertical kingpin by solver steer, then translate suspension delta.
rotation_order.outer_pins: Follow upright yaw and translation; source proper side orientation retained.
rotation_order.retainers: Follow their upper/lower arms, not steering yaw.
rotation_order.wheel_adapter_and_wheel: Follow upright yaw/translation; spin about resulting wheel axle. Do not scale source wheel.
rotation_order.rack: Front native C. Rear originalparts mirroredX in assembly. Moving groups translate globalY by rack r.
rotation_order.tie: Align its nominal centerline to the current inner→outer vector and translate to current inner eye. Tubes are axisymmetric; joint pin axes remain defined separately.
rotation_order.tie_inner_pin: Translate with rack; fixed inclined pin axis.
rotation_order.tie_outer_pin: Rotate with upright; inclined axis yawed by steer.
